name: stacked-sheet-api
description: Four-way vibe test for stacked BottomSheet API design. Every condition uses the same prompts, package name, visual runtime, and blind evaluator; only the public BottomSheet declarations, adapter, and consumer docs vary.

conditions.hypothesis: The root makes ownership obvious and ordinary controlled sheets feel familiar, but coordinating several booleans and branches increases state spread and makes deep links harder.
The smallest markup wins basic generation, but hidden chronology and the absence of a grouping primitive cause branching, deep-link, and unrelated-stack failures.
One serializable stack value improves ordering, branching, and deep links, at the cost of array manipulation and more controller markup.

conditions.internalLabel: Ordered IDs with explicit interaction policy
conditions.hypothesis: Explicit modality, scrim paint, and focus return improve advanced-policy tasks but may add discovery and configuration cost to ordinary flows.

blinding.taskConditionLabels: random opaque tokens generated per experiment

fixtureRule: All variants delegate to one private visual/runtime engine. Adapter differences are limited to state ownership, grouping, public props, and behavior that the public shape cannot express.
